configuration_rule.description: Allow scheduled imports from verified scheduler IPs during Under Attack mode
configuration_rule.expression: (http.host eq "www.ellabo.hr" and http.request.method eq "GET" and len(http.request.uri.args["route"]) eq 1 and len(http.request.uri.args["key"]) eq 1 and http.request.uri.args["key"][0] ne "" and ((ip.src in {198.27.83.222 192.99.21.124 167.114.64.88 167.114.64.21 2607:5300:60:24de:: 2607:5300:60:467c:: 2607:5300:60:6558:: 2607:5300:60:6515::} and ((http.request.uri.path eq "/admin/index.php" and http.request.uri.args["route"][0] eq "extension/module/product_quick_edit/updateStockFromXML") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/index.php" and http.request.uri.args["route"][0] eq "extension/module/ag_specials_cron/updateSpecialPricesUnified"))) or (ip.src in {116.203.129.16 116.203.134.67 23.88.105.37 128.140.8.200 91.99.23.109} and http.request.uri.path eq "/admin/index.php" and http.request.uri.args["route"][0] eq "extension/module/product_quick_edit/importProductsFromXML")))

verification_required_before_global_unde: Review, validate, commit and push this manifest before applying its Cloudflare configuration rule.
Confirm the rule is accepted and enabled with no later conflicting configuration rule.
Verify each existing scheduled job retains its backend key and reaches the application from its bound provider.
Verify production feed locations and successful XML downloads from the application server before running any import under global Under Attack mode.
Confirm successful application responses for all three imports, then enable the target global Under Attack setting and verify normal public traffic remains protected.

Production confirmed on 2026-11-04: all four configured same-host XML feeds exist under the local xml directory; publish and validate the local ImportFeed reader before enabling global Under Attack mode.
security_notes: Provider IPs are public shared execution addresses, not authentication; the existing IMPORT_XML_KEY checks remain required.
Exactly one route argument and exactly one nonempty key argument are required. No key value is stored or validated at the Cloudflare layer.
Only security_level is overridden for the three provider-bound endpoints; no broad WAF or bot-protection skip is requested.
Order exports, other paths, other routes, other providers, other methods and other hostnames are outside this exception.
